reason: Although the finding is phrased with the diff direction reversed, its substantive claim about the BEFORE code — that keys are included only if present on input or if output is not undefined, so a required-output defaulted field yielding `undefined` for an absent key loses its key — is exactly the bug reported in the linked issue (`prefault(undefined)` makes `parse({})` return `{}`) and fixed by replacing `mayOutputUndefined` with `mayOmitUndefined` plus the new comment "defaulted required outputs keep their keys even when undefined".
